scope: One16record synthetic complete review table, all parsed values and record/object-key order retained via source-bound lossless column/row transport. Two fresh native no-tool total input+output observations. Excludes raw JSON whitespace/number spellings, actual role-fanout/retrieval, long-horizon/statistical/cash or whole-development net gains.

implementation.procedure: Inspect new full-array encoder/host-bound restoration/CLI and frozen actual source.
implementation.acceptance: No selection or missing values; preserve JSON semantics and all array/object encounter order; fallback for nonuniform/nonshorter input.

reference_boundary.procedure: Independent all-field/value/order restoration oracle; strict whole-source and tampered decoder/shape negative tests.
reference_boundary.acceptance: Duplicate keys/nonfinite overflow/surrogates/UTF8/path/symlink/staleSHA/shape and budget failures; heterogeneous/empty/no-saving source full fallback, no truncation.

data_integrity.procedure: Freeze actual source import closure/inputs/packets/config/environment; preserve original raw provider events and failures.
data_integrity.acceptance: Exactly2admitted fresh calls, no retries/tools/reroute, observable non-task/settings controls equal.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Recompute total/input/output/reasoning/cache from original notifications and compare both fixed complete-table oracle answers.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Baseline total > candidate total, count all actual pair usage; no cache subtraction or cash claim.

measurement_validity.procedure: Same question/schema/model/effort/non-task instructions/tools; both packets contain all16records and allfields.
measurement_validity.acceptance: Only representation changes; exact source/global/reproduction/current blockers preserved; no artificial fielddrop or free extra inference/recovery.

reproducibility.procedure: Separate actual manual context independently replays encoder/decoder, boundary tests, native event/control equality and oracle.
reproducibility.acceptance: Frozen plan/source and positive usable-with-scope proof; explicit manual-not-Engine and short-fixture/no-whole-workflow limits.
